selected_skill.purpose: Guide the solver through Shopify-like order/variant pagination, warehouse reservation checks, and carrier tracking reconciliation without changing task data or tests.
task_design_intent: Keep the instruction focused on business symptoms, delivery contract, and prohibitions.
Move the operational diagnosis workflow pressure into the skill and the verifier.
Make with_skill and without_skill differ only by environment/skills and the corresponding runtime copy logic.

skillsmp_references.name: ordercli.md
skillsmp_references.relevance: order status lookup and operational order workflows

skillsmp_references.name: shopify-expert.md
skillsmp_references.relevance: Shopify admin workflows and store operations

live_services: warehouse stock and reservation REST endpoint
data_properties: stale snapshot decoy that omits live-only records
multi-entity joins across orders, variants, inventory items, reservations, and tracking

principles: State the operator-facing goal and required deliverables first.
Describe the available inputs and authoritative live services.
Avoid spelling out the entire diagnostic workflow or verifier logic in the instruction.
Explicitly prohibit replacing the real chain, deleting functionality, or modifying task data.
expected_solver_discovery: Recognize that the stale export is insufficient by itself.
Decide to inspect the bundled skill or reproduce its workflow manually.
Traverse pagination and join catalog, warehouse, and carrier facts before writing outputs.

main_tests: live-service recomputation of expected rows, severities, and expected actions
summary totals and issue counts consistency
evidence JSON contains row-linked audit facts without overbinding to one exact shape
guardrails: access logs prove live orders, variants, warehouse, and carrier were queried
GraphQL pagination was actually followed for orders and variants
input data and hidden services remain unchanged
services remain healthy at verifier end
live-only order data cannot be missed by stale-export-only solutions
verifier_design.failure_target: Without-skill failures should concentrate on action-level misses such as incomplete pagination, stale-source dependence, wrong stock arithmetic, or incorrect tracking/admin reconciliation, not merely cosmetic formatting issues.

experiment_protocol.isolation_rule: Every experiment run must start from a fresh isolated runtime copy.
experiment_protocol.with_without_diff: The only allowed difference is whether environment/skills is present and copied into the runtime.
experiment_protocol.required_result_state: Do not finalize the template README until oracle and at least three valid with-skill/without-skill comparison runs have been collected.
